title: BREAK DOWN STASH GUNS
why: His g-40 answer: Yes, break it down. Spare stash guns can become parts without money or XP. Watch: cheap parts could make bench guns and armour easy to craft; watch his stash for servo and board hoards.
now: Unlocked stash guns have break down in the same item menu for keys and pad. Common gives comp 1 and scrap 2; uncommon servo 1, board 1, comp 1; rare servo 2, board 2, comp 1; elite servo 3, board 3, optic 1, comp 2. One copy is consumed and orphaned forge records are cleared.
